color.note: One stock, one key plate and one stamp: aniline violet. The categories are muted printing inks (umber, graphite, plum, ochre), never interface colors; the theme has no green, orange, vermilion or brand blue. Three editions: prensa (cold newsprint, the default), archivo (an old yellowed edition in sepia) and microfilm (the negative on a library reader).

tokens.name: papel
tokens.usage: Primitive: the stock. Prensa is cold grey newsprint (not cream, which is cartel); archivo is an old edition gone yellow; microfilm is the negative on the reader of a newspaper library.

tokens.name: papel-alto
tokens.usage: Primitive: one sheet above the stock (fields, menus, boxed notices).

tokens.name: papel-hondo
tokens.usage: Primitive: one sheet below the stock (code, figures, the cut-out coupon).

tokens.name: tinta
tokens.usage: Primitive: the key plate. Warm black in prensa, sepia in archivo, the light of the reader in microfilm.

tokens.name: tinta-gris
tokens.usage: Primitive: the key plate at half pressure: datelines, credits, excerpts.

tokens.name: filete
tokens.usage: Primitive: hairline rules between columns and rows. Decorative: it never delimits a control.

tokens.name: filete-firme
tokens.usage: Primitive: the rule of a control (fields, the secondary button).

tokens.name: anilina
tokens.usage: Primitive: aniline violet, the ink of a mimeograph and of a postmark. The one accent of the theme, darker on paper and lighter on the film.

tokens.name: sepia
tokens.usage: Primitive: a muted printing ink, burnt umber. Category 2.

tokens.name: grafito
tokens.usage: Primitive: a muted printing ink, graphite. Category 3.

tokens.name: ciruela
tokens.usage: Primitive: a muted printing ink, plum. Category 4.

tokens.name: ocre
tokens.usage: Primitive: a muted printing ink, dark ochre. Category 5 and warnings.

tokens.name: granate
tokens.usage: Primitive: garnet, only for errors and destructive actions, always with a word.

tokens.name: plomo
tokens.usage: Primitive: lead grey, for success: a neutral ink with its glyph and its word, because the theme has no green.

tokens.name: line-strong

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Datelines, credits, excerpts and help.

tokens.name: accent-hover

tokens.name: link

shadow.note: Paper does not float: no shadow, no glow. The one ring is the focus of a field, a rule of the stamp ink.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A raised block is a ruled box, not a lifted one.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating controls carry a rule instead (theme.css).

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: No glow on the accent button.

tokens.name: glow-link
tokens.usage: The focus of fields and interactive surfaces: a 2px rule of the stamp ink, because the core gives comment fields no other indicator.

spacing.note: 4px base. A page is set in columns: tight inside a column, a full gutter with a hairline between columns.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between the sections of a page, like the white between two stories.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter between columns; a column rule sits in its middle.

tokens.name: space-inline
tokens.usage: Side margin of the page.

radius.note: Metal type has square corners: nothing is rounded, not even avatars.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars are square portraits, as in a newspaper.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Width of the broadsheet.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Width of a reading column with its side margins: about 60 characters of the body text.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Height of the bar header (not used by this theme's centered header).

motion.note: A newspaper does not move. The one motion is ink settling on a hover, under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
